#!/bin/bash
# exp-011: Start vLLM with LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct
# Non-Qwen architecture for Claim 2 cross-model-family validation
#

#   bash scripts/start_vllm_llama_8b.sh          # foreground

    --model "$MODEL" \
    --max-model-len 8192 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \

    --trust-remote-code \

EOF
